classification: Genuinely separate physical eligibility proposal after v1 was falsified on normal-only data; v1 remains rejected and is not retuned.

v1_failure.physical_attribution: The maxima occur at payload acquisition settling near effective grip age 48 ms and at the public table-support/place state, not during settled unsupported loaded motion. A global loaded-motion change bound cannot distinguish 6--8 N forces.

mechanism: Apply the same formal change scores only to causally settled, unsupported loaded motion: the observer-effective grip state must have been continuously true for 96 samples and the observer-effective public table-geometry support gate must be false. These are physical state gates derived from public joint/model state, not target times.

fixed_feature_rule.coherence: Successive eligible eight-sample force changes must have positive dot product.
fixed_feature_rule.ineligible_behavior: Reset onset, pending, pulse, ownership, and history immediately.

formal_fit_rule.onset_threshold_N: 1.05 * maximum eligible v2 fit onset score + 0.05 N
formal_fit_rule.sustain_threshold_N: 1.05 * maximum eligible v2 fit 32-sample displacement + 0.05 N

normal_data.fit: The same locked eight fit payload/COM/offset cases and two fit mechanics, recaptured with observer-effective eligibility telemetry.
normal_data.audit: The same disjoint eight audit cases and two disjoint audit mechanics, never used to change parameters.

falsifiers: Any candidate-only alarm on any eligible fit or audit normal sample.
Any use of current rather than observer-effective table/grip eligibility.
Any native R26 or physical trace difference caused by passive capture.
forced_gate_deferred: After a passing normal audit, freeze model/candidate/protocol hashes and only then run disclosed forced targets because the independent R27 challenge is already presealed.
